meta.title: Debrief · portfolio review
meta.description: Holdings, trades, watchlist, instrument search, reports, and investment memory through the debrief data kernel: 20 tools, 5 scheduled review skills, DSH Schedule task presets, and a Portfolio page with add/edit/remove for holdings and watchlist entries, per-row currency units, and a total-assets display-currency switcher. All model work runs in the DSH agent.

commands.debrief-setup: Validate the debrief kernel and idempotently register every scheduled review task (after-market ×4 markets / news / weekly / monthly / memory compaction)
